name: Kemflo International Co., Ltd.
summary: Kemflo International Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells household, commercial, and swimming pool filtration and water treatment systems, metallic equipment, car equipment, and outdoor products in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers water treatment products, including residential water, commercial water, and pool and spa filtration products, as well as cargo management equipment. It also provides water treatment solutions for enterprises and water treatment equipment maintenance and services. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Pingtung, Taiwan.
